desc: Introducing Savage REVEL: a sleek, modern take on the classic lever action rimfire rifle. Crafted with precision engineering and advanced materials, this rifle embodies a fusion of tradition and innovation. Its streamlined design features a contoured walnut stock with intricate checkering for superior grip and comfort. The lever action mechanism delivers smooth and reliable cycling, while the crisp trigger ensures precise shot placement. Simple, quick take-down makes this your new go-to backpack rifle. Equipped with a tubular magazine, REVEL offers ample firepower for plinking or small game hunting. With its timeless aesthetics and cutting-edge performance, this rifle sets a new standard in rimfire firearms.
